Select IC50 activity records for CHEMBL3183703 and its salt forms against target CHEMBL1741208. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL3183703 to retrieve all related forms. For each compound, retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: join compound_records on molregno, docs on doc_id, activities on record_id, assays on assay_id, and target_dictionary on tid. Filter activities by standard_type = 'IC50' and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208'. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
